integrity_notes: Theorem 5.8 of the originating paper provides the genus, branch data and normal form. Only exact parameter redundancy, its complete invariant and self-normalization of the specified subgroup are claimed as new. All checks are self-review; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns pairs consisting of a genus-six curve over an algebraically closed field of characteristic two and a distinguished unlabelled cyclic subgroup of order twelve, not unmarked curves or arithmetic descent; full automorphism groups are not determined.
title: Exact parameters and self-normalizing deck groups for wild cyclic genus-six covers
